name: yogabern (Iyengar Yoga-Schule Bern)
reason: Too thin on items: the site (robots.txt allows us; /signup is disallowed) has only two items with their own URLs, the class subscriptions on the Kurse page and a home-practice PDF; the pranayama and summer workshops share the Kurse page, and the two-year training ended in spring 2026 with no next course published. Worth revisiting: founded in 1991 by Wilfrid Schichl and inaugurated by B.K.S. Iyengar, five certified teachers.
